findings.title: Shared output table grain documentation
findings.evidence: The repository documents grain for every gold output and every Dim/Fact table. Gold outputs: README.md states the gold layer is "Aggregated, warehouse-ready records" and MarketRate_Pipeline/03_LoadToWarehouse.py docstring/comments specify "Grain : One row per product_key per market_date" for the gold-to-warehouse load; MarketRate_Pipeline/02_TransformData.py also states "Grain of output: one row per product_key per market_date." Dim/Fact tables: MarketRate_SQL/CreateEthanolMarketRateFact.sql states "Grain  : One row per product per market date," and MarketRate_SQL/CreateProductDim.sql states "Grain  : One row per unique product (Type 2 SCD)."
